raw_text:
To: Dr. Bob Suber

From: Dr. Deborah A. Lee Ms. Cindy Fulp

Subject: Ames results on sample H81 from Hazleton Biotechnologies, Inc.

The following results were obtained for sample H81 (Firnova Powder 850.005):

## 0X S9 ACTIVATION

strain TA98 strain TA100 strain 1535 strain 1537 strain 1538 (rev/mg sample) (rev/mg sample) (rev/mg sample) (rev/mg sample) (rev/mg sample)

.350 (neg) 5.30 (neg) .118 (neg) .0887 (neg) negative

## 10X S9 ACTIVATION

strain TA98 strain TA100 strain 1535 strain 1537 strain 1538 (rev/mg sample) (rev/mg sample) (rev/mg sample) (rev/mg sample) (rev/mg sample)

.183 (neg) .692 (neg) 1.03 (neg) 1.05 (neg) .816 (neg)

Conclusions: The dose range tested was 0, 100, 500, 1000, 2500, 5000, and 10000 ug in 50 ul. There was no significant increase in revertant number with an increase in dose level for sample H81 with or without S9 activation for any of the S strains.

Please feel free to discuss these results with our lab.



xc: Dr. C.K. Lee Dr. G.T. Burger Dr. J.R. Hayes

The image displays a close-up view of a handwritten note on a white background. The handwriting is in black ink, with a cursive style that is legible and fluid. The text reads "Cindy Fu" followed by a smiley face, indicating a personal or informal message. The smiley face is drawn with a simple line for the mouth and two dots for the eyes, which are positioned above the line of text. The handwriting appears to be done with a pen, as indicated by the slight variations in the thickness of the lines and the curvature of the letters. The paper on which the note is written has a smooth texture, and the edges of the paper are not visible in the image. The overall composition is simple, with the focus being on the handwritten message.
